contentList.content: Non-Combatant
This creature will not join combat.
Toggle Non-Combatant
Enable to make this companion and their summons vanish from the material plane while combat is happening.
Non-Combatants Teleport to You

Enable to make non-combatant companions who are grouped with you teleport to you when they reappear after combat. If this is disabled, noncombatants do not move from where they were before combat started.
If combat ended because the players fled a hostile area, then non-combatants are always teleported to you, even if this setting is disabled.
Toggle Non-Combatants Vanish
Enable to make non-combatants vanish from the material plane even if no combat is happening.
Non-Combatants Dismissed
Non-combatants are currently dismissed, even if no combat is happening.
Non-combatants won't join dialogues while this is enabled.
Followers who are attached to this companion will always join combat, regardless of this setting.
Toggle Non-Combatant
Enable to make this companion not join combat.
This cannot be toggled while any combat is in progress.
Toggle Non-Combatants Forced Off-Stage
Enable to force non-combatants to temporarily stop existing, even if no combat is happening.

Temporary followers who are attached to a companion will always join combat.

Non-combatants will remain in in-progress dialogues even if a combat starts.
The mysterious outer planes are known to occasionally whisk away unsuspecting creatures.
The mysterious outer planes are known to occasionally whisk away unsuspecting creatures.
Test Passive

- This setting cannot be changed while any combat is in progress.
- Non-combatants staying alive won't prevent a game-over from all party members dying.
Non-combatants who are in a dialogue remain in the dialogue until it finishes. They are still considered dismissed immediately for all other intents and purposes.

- Characters who temporarily join the party as attached followers never become non-combatants.
- Extraplanar travel breaks concentration, and can remove a few types of conditions.
- Upon returning to the material plane, there may be a delay in conditions displaying or taking effect.
- Non-combatants always remain in dialogues that they've already joined.
